text: Sacred political orders under crisis can escalate sacrifice, collapse, freeze, transform, or restrain themselves depending on correction capacity and institutional embodiment.
falsificationCriteria: Comparable cases repeatedly show no relationship between correction capacity and outcome differentiation.
Sacrificial escalation, collapse, and restrained reordering can be explained without reference to sacred-political-order claims or institutional embodiment.
High-corrigibility cases systematically escalate sacrifice at the same rate as low-corrigibility cases under similar crisis pressure.

text: Political pathology includes maladaptive sacrifice, suppression of correction, collapse, frozen dysfunction, and successor-order transformation, not only overt mass violence.
falsificationCriteria: Operational coding cannot distinguish restrained sacrifice from pathological sacrifice.
Cases coded as collapse, frozen pathology, or absorption-transformation lack any traceable mechanism beyond ordinary violence or coercion.
Counterevidence shows the pathology construct collapses into outcome labels rather than explaining them.
